label: Mid/late original phase through <DEL>, when the sequence started with x/h/m/i
explanation: Fires from about step 3 of the original phase through the <DEL> step (78% of mass in the original phase, 19% on <DEL>), almost never at t<3 or during the copy phase (2.6% of mass, mostly the first copy step). It is gated by the identity of the earliest tokens: first_tok in {x,h,m,i} has 4-5x lift and 72% of mass, and restricting to that alone gives 0.92 precision. Including x/h/m/i at position 1 raises mass recall to 0.89 at precision 0.71. Magnitude is largest when the sequence opens with x (top examples begin x x or x h), climbs over the first few steps to a peak around t=4-7, and falls off a little at <DEL>. When the trigger token is only at position 1 or later, activations are weaker and start later. Weak low-quartile activations occur in sequences with no early x/h/m/i, which the predicate misses. The current input token barely matters (lift about 1x).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: x, h, i, m, 1, r; least: w, k, c, a) and the second original token (most: x, h, i, m, 1, v; least: 2, q, w, k); timing cues that raise it most: t=4, t=6, t=5.
